Frozen protocol-100 inventory frames pin the source inspector's consumed wire layout. The envelope, request tags, Session, TerminalDescriptor, and nested DTO declarations were compared with source protocol 99 (`9aba989a`) and source protocol 100 (`4e12b7f2`) before capture; those declarations are identical. Capture used the populated test builder after current-main integration, rather than an old executable. The test compares exact bytes and independently decodes the four restricted responses. Fields cover paired continuity, owned listeners, environment/unsets, transcript metadata, recovery lineage, and a Unicode terminal title. The Connect frame includes an expected owner and a nonempty resume cursor.
